meta.label: Adoption config inventory
meta.description: Walk <DIP_HOME>/config/projects/<KEY>/ object JSONs and mine creationTag/versionTag (creator login, created ms, last editor, save count) into a full-history inventory of surviving objects: per-family counts + subtypes + edit buckets, monthly creation trend, per-creator and per-project roll-ups. Metadata-only categories (notebooks, SQL notebooks, wiki articles, flow zones, visual analyses) are counted by file mtime — their bodies carry no creation tags. Runs as the dataiku service account so it can read the config tree regardless of webapp impersonation.
